guest.subtitle: Open a demo pack, see the reveal flow, then create an account when you are ready.

demo.title: Open a pack
demo.subtitle: Pick a branded pack and spin a roulette built only from live eBay listings imported through the official sourcing flow. No generated card prizes are shown here.
demo.conversionCopy: The guest demo now uses only imported eBay listing images for prize cards. Real openings still require login, committed seeds, vaulted inventory, and KYC only when a user asks to withdraw funds.

demo.importCopy: Add the eBay credentials, run the import, and this demo will show real listing images from eBay instead of generated card art.
demo.loadError: The API is not reachable or eBay listings have not been imported yet.

help.title: Game, market and custody flow
help.subtitle: Boosters is a phygital card platform: packs reveal vaulted cards, cards can be traded, redeemed, sold back, and withdrawals require KYC approval.
help.packsBody: Pick a pack, pay with your custodial balance, then the commit-reveal draw selects one vaulted prize from that pack pool.
help.marketBody: The Marketplace supports first-party and peer-to-peer listings. Users can list only vaulted, active-token cards they own; risky price deviations go to admin review.
help.kycBody: Signup and deposits stay open. KYC is required only before money-out withdrawals, then staff reviews documents in the admin panel.
help.adminBody: Staff manage users, KYC, vault intake, packs, treasury, redemptions and held marketplace listings from the admin area.
